as_told.title: Intelligence calls to Bill Moore after the Roswell book tour

plain: Around 1980, the story goes, the researcher Bill Moore was touring radio stations to promote his book The Roswell Incident, about a craft said to have crashed in New Mexico in 1947. At station after station, the same mysterious caller kept phoning in. The author Greg Bishop, who passes on what Moore told him, says that in Albuquerque, "the next stop on his book tour, he goes into the radio station, same thing happens, same voice." Those calls, Bishop says, led Moore to meet Rick Doty, an Air Force intelligence man, and an insider known only by the code name Falcon. The UFO researcher Grant Cameron tells it a little differently: the first call came "seven days after he went on the tour" and "was probably from" Doty in Albuquerque. They tell it because it would mean intelligence officers went looking for Moore themselves, to feed him UFO information.
